decision_scope: One bounded static pass over root-authored ops/admit_c4.py and the existing reviewed runtime/template interfaces. No whole inherited-runner re-audit.

independence.role: Independent static review; minimal repairs reported to root, no code modified by reviewer.

blocking_findings.location: main(): cleanup finally and all finalization after measured=cpu(...)
blocking_findings.finding: The exception boundary ends before host receipt serialization, preparation-ledger/code-manifest/template/budget writes and postwrite checking. A cleanup exception or an OSError/serialization exception/SIGXCPU in this finalization region can escape without a failure debit for the full attempt. A completed host receipt may already exist even though finalization did not finish.
blocking_findings.source_evidence: The try/except protects admission/probe only; finally proc.wait may raise; host_pin, ledger_pin, code_pin, budget_pin and C04_POSTWRITE_CHECK are outside that handled try.
blocking_findings.minimal_fix: Use one bounded failure/finalization boundary including cleanup and serialization. Preserve the original host receipt, record any failure and same-attempt cumulative debit without summing the prefix twice, and retain an explicit UNKNOWN/incomplete intent if costs or durable finalization cannot be completed. Do not relabel an unclosed attempt as cpu_accounting_complete.

blocking_findings.severity: current-C4-blocking false admission after explicit refusal
blocking_findings.location: budget_pin write followed by observed_postwrite_covered_by_tail refusal
blocking_findings.finding: EXECUTION_BUDGET.json is created with FROZEN_C4_ADMITTED before the tail check. If post_cpu>charged, main returns3 but leaves that executable budget, a completed host receipt and its ledger in place. The pinned runtime load_budget does not inspect C04_POSTWRITE_CHECK, so those bytes can still pass its admission interface despite the helper explicitly refusing.
blocking_findings.source_evidence: Actual runtime40949ef6 load_budget validates frozen status, pinned host/preparation/code/input records, but has no POSTWRITE_CHECK condition.
blocking_findings.minimal_fix: On every known failure after this helper creates the active budget, remove it from the executable budget path while preserving its exact bytes under a unique failed-artifact name, or publish the active budget only after the bounded success boundary. Never move or overwrite a pre-existing budget not created by this attempt. Keep the failure and any cost amendment durable.

bounded_correction_requests.severity: small preflight claim correction before admission
bounded_correction_requests.finding: The helper accepts all(preflight[guards].values()) and stage C04, then writes source_and_previous_backup_receipts_rechecked=true without testing the preflight source_and_previous_backup_receipt_check field. An empty guards map also passes all().
bounded_correction_requests.minimal_fix: Require the expected preflight schema/stage, each named owner/central guard to be exactly true, same-unit CR branch/HEAD binding and source_and_previous_backup_receipt_check==PASS before recording that claim. This is a small check against the actual preflight interface, not a new survey.

bounded_correction_requests.severity: failure provenance preservation within F01 repair
bounded_correction_requests.finding: PreparationBudgetExceeded replaces receipt[failure] and loses any earlier source/memory/probe exception on the same attempt.
bounded_correction_requests.minimal_fix: Retain the earlier failure separately or in an ordered failure list when adding the budget-exceeded reason.

supported_static_checks.topic: original input and worker code identity
supported_static_checks.evidence: Original inputs receive a size check before read and SHA/size validation; code manifest records every direct implementation/*.py and review/*.py and requires all named worker/runner files. This reviewer did not import, compile or execute any of them.

Uses RAW_HEADROOM_ONLY_V1, zero reclaim credit, selected256MiB+1GiB reserve; separately visible tighter ancestor views refuse for explicit review. Snapshot is correctly called non-atomic and not a guarantee. No inherited file-LRU policy is imported.

Popen known PID is directly read from /proc with parent/pgrp and start identity; child is awaited and probe CPU is already part of whole preparation totals. It is a short sleep probe, not a scientific worker. Cleanup exceptions still require F01 repair.

RUSAGE_SELF plus reaped RUSAGE_CHILDREN includes process startup, input/hash work and the probe; tail .05 is separate and charged=fsum(measured,tail). SIGXCPU soft3/hard4 is catchable within the existing try; this is not proof of a hard aggregate bound.
write_new uses xb; c4_v1 is the only admitted attempt name; no old/parallel budget transfer or old science replay occurs. The single current unit and runtime draft/install separation remain explicit.
